Verbatim upstream license texts from pollen-robotics/microduck_rl,
revision bae39f5900b318f7e87fc485c30a31213cfa14eb.

LICENSE-MODELS.md describes that upstream repository, not the entire demo.
The copied robot.xml is Apache-2.0. Other demo files retain their own licences.

Raw STL files are not published. robot.xml retains mesh filenames as geometry
lookup keys into pollen/microduck.glb, alongside its body, joint and sensor
descriptions. The GLB's exact provenance, inherited CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 mesh terms,
upstream credit, noncommercial and share-alike conditions are recorded in
pollen/MESH-LICENSE.txt, pollen/NOTICE and pollen/SOURCE.json. The GLB bytes are
unchanged; creased normals are recomputed for rendering at load time.
